description: Suggest a named workout for the person to keep and start whenever they like ("Leg day"), rather than a session on one day (that is propose_workout). Nothing is saved until they approve it in the Metrics Nest app, where they can edit it first. Same exercises as propose_workout: exercise_id from list_exercises or list_exercise_catalog where there is one. Make up a new idempotency_key for each suggestion. Works only where the person allowed this connection to suggest (get_profile says can_propose).

activity.description: strength (default), run, ride, hike, swim, row, yoga, hiit or other.

client.description: For a coach: a client id from list_clients, to read that client. Omitted: your own account.

exercises.description: In the order they are to be done.

exercise_id.description: An id from list_exercises. Omit for an exercise they have not done.

notes.description: A cue for this exercise, one line.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per suggestion; the same key again returns the first suggestion instead of a duplicate.

rationale.description: Why this workout, in a few sentences the person reads before approving.

title.description: The name it will be saved under: "Leg day".

name: propose_saved_workout
title: Suggest a saved workout
